attributes.title: 2027 Great Lakes Dental Summit
attributes.summary:
If you have been looking for the MDA Annual Session, this is it under a new name. The Michigan Dental Association's Great Lakes Dental Summit runs May 20 to 22, 2027, at DeVos Place in Grand Rapids.

The association says registration opens in January 2027, together with the course schedule and speaker lineup, so credit hours and fees are not published yet. Hold off on planning your Michigan renewal hours around this meeting until the schedule appears.

The organizer describes the event as evidence-based CE for the whole dental team but does not yet name hygienists or say which credit system applies.
